technical.title: EvalResearchBench introduces autonomous AI agents for recursive self-improvement evaluation.
technical.summary: Researchers introduced EvalResearchBench, a benchmark for autonomous evaluation research where an AI agent synthesizes tasks, implements graders, and revises them to automate the costly process of benchmark design for recursive self-improvement.
technical.why: It automates benchmark design, reducing the high costs associated with recursive self-improvement loops.

technical.title: Microsoft open-sources Agensh, a decentralized multi-agent harness scaling to 1,024 agents.
technical.summary: Microsoft Research open-sourced Agensh, a multi-agent harness lacking a central orchestrator where self-organizing workers share a Git repo, chat, and a findings board to scale from 1 to 1,024 agents.
technical.why: It offers an architecture for scaling self-organizing multi-agent systems without a central orchestrator.

technical.title: Anthropic open-sources sandbox-runtime for OS-level AI agent isolation without containers.
technical.summary: Anthropic released sandbox-runtime, the open-source OS-level sandbox behind Claude Code that restricts file and network access for agents and tools using Seatbelt on macOS and bubblewrap on Linux.
technical.why: It provides a lightweight, container-free method for isolating AI agents and CLI tools at the OS level.

technical.title: NVIDIA TensorRT 11.1 introduces Global Performance Tuner for automated optimization.
technical.summary: The Global Performance Tuner is a feature for automatic, accuracy-aware performance tuning released as part of NVIDIA TensorRT 11.1.
technical.why: It streamlines performance optimization workflows for deep learning deployment.

technical.title: OpenAI details scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users.
technical.summary: OpenAI detailed how it scaled Habitat using reliable multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB to deliver 12 times faster reads for ChatGPT users.
technical.why: It offers valuable engineering insights into scaling distributed storage for massive consumer AI applications.

technical.title: New research reveals confidentiality leaks via the mosaic effect in LLM agents.
technical.summary: Researchers quantified the mosaic effect in agentic LLM systems using synthetic examples and live agent harnesses, finding that even top models disclose forbidden composite conclusions from accessible documents under benign queries.
technical.why: This highlights critical security risks when deploying LLM agents over confidential multi-document data.

technical.title: ID-TAP framework enables test-time persona adaptation for LLM agents.
technical.summary: Researchers presented ID-TAP, an IDS-inspired neural dueling-bandit framework that uses binary comparisons to adapt LLM agents to query-dependent user preferences from lightweight interaction across large persona spaces.
technical.why: It provides a scalable way to personalize LLM agents at test time using efficient binary feedback.

technical.title: Cognition releases an open-source agent plugin for securing systems against RCE flaws.
technical.summary: Cognition released the Devin Vulnerability Fixes plugin, comprising three MIT-licensed agent skills to inventory, patch, and test vulnerable PHP, Node.js, and self-managed GitLab deployments.
technical.why: It provides automated agent tooling to address critical vulnerabilities and manage software patching.

technical.title: OpenAI nears $1.25T 💰, ☁️, 1Password for Agents 🔑, Gemini 3.5 Pro postmortem 🤖
Using AI Agents to Teach Robots Like Microduck to Walk in Simulation
technical.summary: Teaching a robot to navigate an obstacle course requires more than a walking policy. It must perceive its surroundings, maintain balance, and adjust its actions...

business.title: OpenAI Nears $30 Billion Funding Round at $1.25 Trillion Valuation
business.summary: OpenAI is close to finalizing a funding round of up to $30 billion, aiming for a $1.25 trillion valuation as a bridge to its 2027 IPO.
business.why: This massive capital injection shapes the financial landscape and competitive dynamics of the AI industry.

business.title: OpenAI Working on Record $30B Raise at $1.25T Valuation
business.summary: OpenAI is pursuing a $30 billion raise at a $1.25 trillion valuation, which would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.

business.title: Startup Deals Span Robot Training, Space Lasers, and Green Cement
business.summary: Recent startup deals feature diverse technologies, including companies teaching robots everyday household chores and using lasers to track satellites.
business.why: Robot training applications highlight ongoing commercialization trends in physical AI and manipulation.

business.title: Apollo Economist Says AI Delivers Zero Financial Payoff to Companies
business.summary: Despite massive investments and widespread hype, artificial intelligence has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of the tech sector, according to an Apollo economist.

business.title: Turmoil Hits AI Buildout as Neoclouds and Hyperscalers Face Pressure
business.summary: Stock slumps, pulled IPOs, and rising credit default swap spreads are creating turbulence for the AI infrastructure buildout ahead of hyperscaler earnings.

business.title: AI Drives Large Financings for Tenstorrent and Flapping Airplanes
business.summary: AI-related startup funding saw massive rounds go to processor developer Tenstorrent and AI lab Flapping Airplanes alongside various other sectors.
business.why: Tracking processor investments gives insight into hardware supply chains and compute availability.

business.title: AI Funding Fears Rattle Wall Street and Spark Portfolio Adjustments
business.summary: Growing fears regarding AI funding have rattled Wall Street, leading investors to rotate out of AI stocks and into defensive alternatives.

business.title: Compilation Highlights Hottest AI Wearables and Gadgets
business.summary: A new roundup details the latest AI-powered wearables and gadgets, including Muse Charm, Bee, Friend, and Plaud.

business.title: Tracking Global Data Center Development and US Opposition
business.summary: Author Paris Marx discusses global data center development and notes that the US can learn valuable lessons from movements abroad in places like Ireland and New Zealand.

business.title: Reddit Community r/opensource Bans AI Projects and Submissions
business.summary: The moderators of r/opensource implemented new rules explicitly banning projects that use AI, are made by AI, or are intended for AI.

models.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 Released With Improved Reasoning And Faster Execution
models.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing task execution time and output length.
models.why: It advances the performance-cost Pareto frontier for agent harnesses.

models.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash Launches As Native Multimodal Mixture-Of-Experts Model
models.summary: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash supports text, image, and video inputs with a context window up to 1M tokens, using sparse attention and DSpark speculative decoding for enhanced agentic and coding workflows.
models.why: It provides high-efficiency multimodal processing for long-context tasks.

models.title: Shanghai AI Laboratory Introduces Sage-A1.5 Mixture-Of-Experts Agentic Model
models.summary: Sage-A1.5 is a 35B mixture-of-experts agentic model based on Qwen3.6 and Agents-A1, built to advance long-horizon scientific problem solving through adaptive capability composition.
models.why: It targets complex scientific problem-solving with dynamic workflow revision.

models.title: Recursive Introduces Flint Mixture-of-Experts Language Model For Coding Agents
models.summary: Flint is a 39.8B parameter mixture-of-experts model with 2.5B active parameters per token, designed to investigate codebases, fix bugs, implement features, and write tests.
models.why: It provides a specialized tool for codebase navigation and automated software engineering workflows.

models.title: OpenMOSS Releases MOSS-Image-SFT For Supervised Text-To-Image Generation
models.summary: MOSS-Image-SFT is a supervised fine-tuned text-to-image model supporting natural-language prompts, tag sequences, and JSON layouts for text placement and object arrangement.
models.why: It gives developers precise layout control for generated images.

models.title: Uncensored And Quantized Formats Of Qwen-Image-2.1 Released For Local Generation
models.summary: This release provides GGUF, Safetensors, and MLX quantized formats of Qwen-Image-2.1 for local image generation using original upstream base weights and ComfyUI support.
models.why: It enables local deployment of Qwen-Image-2.1 across various hardware architectures.
